crucialFeats: Universe after universe has fallen before his might.
Turns DC Earth and everyone in it into stone.
Monitor ranks him on the same threat level as Spectre.
Destroys a planet with a glance.

dossier.advantage: Dominion over dimensions and souls. Trigon is not just a physical threat — he attacks the opponent's very essence and imposes his will on entire worlds.
dossier.mentality: Pure evil and sadistic narcissism. He does not fight to survive, but for total domination and humiliation of all life.
dossier.quote: Your world is mine. Your souls are my toys. Trigon is coming!
dossier.style: Magical domination and infernal pressure. He uses hellish power to destroy the minds and bodies of enemies before they can grasp the scale of the threat.

fighterA.name: Trigon

powers: Reality manipulation, infernal magic, soul absorption, and near-unbounded energy projection.
tools: Ability to create demon armies and corrupt heroes.
Dimensional control, allowing him to dictate the battlefield and appear where the opponent has no comfortable answer.
weaknesses: In some realms, full manifestation still requires a proper passage or weakened dimensional barriers.
Arrogance can make him dismiss seemingly minor threats for too long.

crucialFeats: Possesses Ultimate Nullifier, a weapon that can destroy the entire universe.
Galactus must exist or the universe dies.
Galactus' attack encompasses three solar systems.
The whole universe was at risk of destruction when Galactus fought.
Sends Sphinx back in time to relive his life over and over for an eternity.

dossier.advantage: Power Cosmic and existential scale. Galactus does not fight - he executes a consumption process. He controls the universe's fundamental forces at an unimaginable level.
dossier.mentality: An amoral force of nature. He does not kill from hatred, but from hunger. He sees planets and gods as fuel required to maintain cosmic balance.
dossier.quote: I am not a god. I am not a monster. I am Galactus. I am inevitability.
dossier.style: Cosmic manipulation and erasure. He uses the Power Cosmic to break down matter, absorb energy, and impose his will on entire worlds.

fighterB.name: Galactus

powers: Power Cosmic and cosmic-scale manipulation of matter and energy.
tools: Ultimate Nullifier (in extreme cases) - a weapon capable of destroying entire continuums.
Ability to create heralds who carry out his will.
weaknesses: Hunger - his power drops drastically when he does not consume planets.

battle-dynamics.label: Hungry Galactus • Material Space
battle-dynamics.phase_1: In material space, Trigon does not get the bonus of his own realm, but a starving Galactus also does not operate with the full scale of his cosmic edge.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Galactus uses the Power Cosmic to impose his own order on the fight, yet hunger gives Trigon more time to build metaphysical pressure.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: In a longer clash, Trigon starts to turn the pressure back, but in material space Galactus still wins slightly more often through greater energy scale and durability.
battle-dynamics.analysis: Hunger weakens Galactus heavily, yet in material space it still leaves him a slight edge. This is one of his narrowest winning scenarios.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: In material space, a well-fed Galactus fights at his highest level from the very start.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: Energy scale, durability, and matter control allow him to strip more and more initiative away from Trigon.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: At this level of power, Galactus more and more often pushes Trigon onto the defensive and closes the fight on his own terms.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: This is the most favorable version of the fight for Galactus: high satiation clearly tilts the clash in his favor.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_1: Inside Trigon's realm, the nature of the battlefield itself favors infernal pressure more than cosmic stabilization from the start.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_2: Hunger strips Galactus of part of the scale he needs to impose his own conditions against Trigon's full metaphysical presence.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_3: In that configuration, Trigon most often takes over through realm control, soul pressure, and corruption of the fight's very logic.
battle-dynamics.s3_analysis: This is one of the worst variants for Galactus: hunger weakens him precisely when he is fighting on ground that fully belongs to Trigon.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_1: Even a well-fed Galactus does not get the same comfort in Trigon's realm that he enjoys in material space.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_2: Full Power Cosmic scale keeps him in the fight and prevents a quick collapse, but the realm itself still pushes the clash toward metaphysics.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_3: This is the closest fight inside Trigon's realm: Galactus is far more dangerous here than in starvation, yet Trigon's own dimension still tilts the clash his way more often.
battle-dynamics.s4_analysis: Galactus's satiation greatly reduces the edge of Trigon's realm, but it does not erase it completely.

fight-simulation.label: Hungry Galactus • Material Space
fight-simulation.opening: Galactus enters the fight in material space, but hunger limits his ability to impose full superiority quickly from the start.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Trigon uses every moment of delay to push the clash toward something more metaphysical than purely cosmic.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Galactus still has enough scale to stay ahead, but he does so far less comfortably than in satiation.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Galactus wins very narrowly, more often through endurance and scale than through full domination.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Galactus starts with the edge in scale, but from the opening it is already clear that hunger has taken away some of his certainty and finishing power.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: Trigon begins pushing the clash toward soul pressure, corruption, and dimensional stress.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Galactus still answers with greater raw scale.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: In material space, Galactus still closes the fight more often, but only after dragging it back his way with difficulty.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: This is one of his narrowest winning variants.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: Trigon loses, but is not easily dominated.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: A well-fed Galactus enters the fight from the start, using the full scale of the Power Cosmic.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: Energy scale, durability, and matter control strip more and more room away from Trigon to impose his own logic on the fight.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_b: Galactus pushes him onto the defensive more and more often.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Galactus closes the fight on his own terms before Trigon's soul pressure and corruption can take control of the clash.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_a: This is the most favorable variant for Galactus.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: In material space and at high satiation, he leads very clearly.
fight-simulation.s2_end_condition: Galactus wins clearly in material space when he is not fighting in starvation.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_1_event: Trigon's own dimension pushes the fight toward infernal pressure from the start, while Galactus's hunger robs him of part of the scale he needs.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_event: Galactus fails to take control of the course of the fight. Trigon's realm dictates the pace and conditions of the clash.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_a: The Power Cosmic does not disappear, but it becomes less comfortable to use.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_b: Trigon takes over both the tempo and the nature of the clash.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_event: Trigon takes control through realm pressure, soul corruption, and contamination of the fight's very logic.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_branch_a: This is one of the worst variants for Galactus.
fight-simulation.s3_end_condition: Trigon wins in his own realm when Galactus enters it in starvation.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_1_event: A fed Galactus enters the fight far more dangerous than in starvation, but Trigon's realm immediately takes away his full freedom to impose his own conditions.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_event: The full scale of the Power Cosmic keeps Galactus in the fight, yet Trigon's realm still pushes the battle beyond a clean exchange of cosmic scale.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_branch_a: Galactus is genuinely fighting for the win here.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_branch_b: Trigon still has the edge of home ground.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_event: A fed Galactus can fight on even terms for a long time, but Trigon's realm ultimately gives its master the win.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_branch_a: Galactus is very dangerous, but not enough to break the ground advantage.
fight-simulation.s4_end_condition: Trigon still wins more often even against a fed Galactus if the fight takes place inside his own realm.

final-summary.line_1: This is a clash between two different orders of power: Galactus's cosmic consumption and Trigon's metaphysical domination.
final-summary.line_2: What matters most is how well fed Galactus is and whether Trigon is fighting in his own realm.
final-summary.line_3: The more the fight tilts toward a fully fed Galactus or Trigon's own domain, the more the entire balance of the clash changes.
final-summary.winner: Galactus leads in material space. Trigon gains enormously in his own realm.

tactical-board.lane: The winner must control the dimension where the fight takes place.
tactical-board.subtitle: Devourer versus Demon

verdict-matrix.subtitle: Verdict depends on Galactus's satiation level and the battlefield
verdict-matrix.case_1: Galactus 5.5/10. In material space he still has the edge through scale and the Power Cosmic, but hunger clearly weakens his ability to close the fight quickly against Trigon.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Galactus 9/10. Well fed and fighting in material space, he gets the most favorable version of this matchup: greater energy scale and greater stability.
verdict-matrix.case_3: Trigon 9/10. A starving Galactus inside Trigon's realm lands in the worst possible configuration: weaker cosmic pressure and a battlefield subordinated to the infernal ruler's will.
verdict-matrix.case_4: Trigon 6/10. A fed Galactus is much more dangerous in the realm than he is in starvation, but Trigon's own dimension still tilts the fight his way more often.

x-factor.mechanika: A well-fed Galactus and a Trigon fighting in his own realm are not the same versions of these characters as their weaker forms in neutral space.
x-factor.implikacja: The more the fight tilts toward a fully fed Galactus or a battlefield that belongs to Trigon, the less ordinary stats are enough to describe the outcome.
x-factor.psychologia: Galactus wants to consume and stabilize. Trigon wants to corrupt and dominate. Whichever side keeps its preferred state and environment longer changes the entire nature of the clash.
